description: The pace bands of one track (docs/SPEC.md FR-4.8): five equal bins over the track's own range of speeds, slowest 0 to fastest 4, as runs of point indices; a run starts at the point before the one whose speed it takes, so neighbouring runs share their boundary point. Run by the server (internal/httpapi) and by Android for the Sync tab's candidates, which aren't on the server. Input: speeds, one per point. Expected: [{ band, start, end }], end inclusive.

cases.name: runs share their boundary point and cover the whole track
five equal bins, the top speed in the last
a flat track is all one band
the first point's speed only sets the scale
fewer than two points have no runs
